text: I must have been about nine, when my dad let me use his laptop. I mostly played simple browser games and watched cartoons, since I didn't really understand how to search for information yet.

text: I use different passwords for each account and turn on two-step verification. I'm also careful about clicking on suspicious links, ever since I received a fake email pretending to be from my bank.
